desc: 白底叠码主图接拧水卖点、织纹微距与成套陈列的八镜厨房纺织套图
name: 华夫格织纹厨房洗碗抹布款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整齐叠码与拱起顶条展示成套件数与织纹
一秒讲清含水面主张，用双手拧出大量清水的动作坐实卖点
shots.textZone: 左上角圆角胶囊标题位与其下方细线图标位

shots.intent: 用满幅织纹与圆形放大镜位证明结构与工艺，承接吸水卖点做机制解释
正俯视真实洗碗瞬间，让买家代入自家水槽场景
一屏展示成套多条与挂收两种用法，让买家判断件数与搭配
以摊平正方形与手掌锚点消除大小疑虑，规格数值留给下游填写
shots.textZone: 下缘与右侧两条空档尺寸标注位

shots.intent: 双栏同框对比压紧与蓬松两种折叠状态，证明运输后形态可恢复
shots.textZone: 顶部横向标题条位与两栏底部胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 全家福平铺加空白凭证框收口降风险，为下游资质留位
shots.textZone: 底部一排空白印章框位与其上方短主张行

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust layout, warm milk-white #F6EFE6 for info and comparison panels, airy near-white kitchen field #FBF8F4 and pale painted-brick wall #F1EDE8 for scenes
style.iconSystem: flat thin single-weight line icons in the accent colour #E4572E, no fill, maximum one icon per screen
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key daylight-balanced studio light around 5500K, front-left softbox key with white bounce fill, soft contact shadows, low sweeping skimming highlight on textile texture, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bright kitchen textile visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, warm milk-white #F6EFE6, misted slate fabric #5C626C and one accent #E4572E; neutral high-key daylight around 5500K with a front-left soft key, white bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one rounded pill headline and small pill labels; flat thin-line icon style in the accent colour only; matte stone counter and pale painted-brick surface language; stable folded-stack and spread-square scale with the weave face always readable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented numbers or certification marks.
noDrift: no invented numbers or certification marks on spec screens
style.presentationRules: folded stack, single draped piece and spread square keep one consistent scale across the set; the weave face always stays readable and props never cover it; hands may enter frame but never a face
style.surfaceSystem: matte beige stone-look counter #E9DFD1, white ceramic basin #F4F3F1, pale painted-brick wall #F1EDE8, fabric field in misted slate #5C626C
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline in a rounded pill chip plus small pill labels, all rendered copy kept as placeholders and never dense body text
